description: Reads what a webinar earned: paid orders and the amount per currency, open orders, refunds, and which offer tier sold how often and for how much. Money comes from the host's own shop, never from an estimate. Take it when a host asks about the money, for example "Which package did they buy?" It needs the session id and reads only from the connected site, changing nothing. Two currencies are never added together, each line stays on its own. For what a single person spent, the registrant list is the right place. Without a connected site the answer carries example numbers (sample: true) and the next step. Words hosts use: revenue, sales, which package, orders, refunds

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id. Leave it out to read all webinars.

name: wi_get_webinar_revenue_woocommerce
title: Read webinar revenue and which offer tier sold
